{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the conversion fraction
conversion_fraction = loyal_df['converted'].mean()

# Print the raw numbers that will be used in evidence
print("Total loyal customers:", len(loyal_df))
print("Loyal customers who converted:", loyal_df['converted'].sum())
print("Conversion fraction:", conversion_fraction)"}
